userStories.notes: Committed 20be9304. distill(user_id, assistant_id, store) added to PromptOptimizer. Retrieves up to 50 recent trajectories from (user_id, 'trajectories', assistant_id) namespace. Gets current assistant system_prompt/instructions. Constructs langmem Prompt and OptimizerInput, runs optimize(). Extracts optimized text, compares to current prompt (returns None if no improvement).
